title: Closed for the Raid
teaser: A rainy night in the 20th Ward. Outside, the CCG is conducting a raid, and Anteiku closed early: everyone who didn't get away in time is waiting it out inside, ghouls and humans alike. At 23:40 waitress Touka Kirishima was found in the basement. An ordinary knife can't hurt a ghoul, and she was wounded with a kagune or a quinque. Her kakuhou has been cut out, and she's wearing her rabbit mask, though Touka never wore it in the café. There's no leaving by the street: the Doves are at the door.

habits.label: Drinks only black coffee
habits.habit: Drinks their coffee only black, no sugar or milk
clues: A black coffee cup, still warm, stands on a basement step. The culprit drinks only black coffee.
The barista found one espresso missing, and the empty cup later turned up in the back room by the stairs down. The culprit drinks only black coffee.

habits.label: Cracks a finger
habits.habit: Cracks a finger joint when nervous
clues: A customer at the counter heard dry clicks from behind the basement door, as if someone were cracking their fingers. The culprit cracks their fingers.
At 23:30 the manager went down for coffee beans and heard a knuckle crack behind him on the stairs. The culprit cracks their fingers.

habits.label: Eyepatch
habits.habit: Wears a white medical patch over one eye
clues: A torn elastic from an eyepatch lies under the basement stairs. The culprit wears an eyepatch.
In the back room bin there's a fresh cotton pad with a spot of blood, the kind used when changing an eyepatch. The culprit wears an eyepatch.

habits.label: Never without a novel
habits.habit: Carries a battered paperback novel everywhere
clues: A bookshop bookmark lies on the basement floor. The culprit never goes anywhere without a book.
A page torn from a novel, with a dog-eared corner, lies next to Touka. The culprit never goes anywhere without a book.

habits.label: Black umbrella
habits.habit: Never lets go of a long black umbrella, even indoors
clues: A trail of raindrops, like from a wet umbrella, runs from the basement door down the steps. The culprit carries an umbrella.
The concrete by the body has round dents from the sharp tip of an umbrella. The culprit carries an umbrella.

habits.label: Smells of roses
clues: The basement smells of roses, though the café never keeps flowers. The culprit smells of rose cologne.
Touka's collar carries someone else's sweet rose scent. The culprit smells of rose cologne.

habits.label: Scarred palm
habits.habit: An old quinque scar runs right across their palm
clues: The painted basement door has a bloody palm print with a smooth pale line across it, like a scar. The culprit has a scar on their palm.
Touka's apron has the print of someone else's hand with the same line through the middle. The culprit has a scar on their palm.

habits.label: Metal case
habits.habit: Never lets go of a heavy metal case
clues: The edges of the basement steps have fresh scratches from metal corners. The culprit carries a metal case.
On the basement floor by the pillar there's a rectangular mark where something heavy and flat was put down. The culprit carries a metal case.

habits.label: Five sugars
habits.habit: Puts five spoons of sugar in their coffee and stirs until the cup rings
clues: Granulated sugar is spilled on the basement stairs, crunching underfoot. The culprit takes a lot of sugar in their coffee.
The basement door handle is sticky with sweet coffee: someone grabbed it without wiping their fingers. The culprit takes a lot of sugar in their coffee.

habits.label: Hood up
habits.habit: Never takes their hood down, even at a table
clues: A student sitting by the window saw a figure with a hood pulled low walk to the basement door. The culprit wears a hood.
Grey threads torn from a hoodie at head height hang on a nail by the basement entrance. The culprit wears a hood.

habits.label: Big headphones
habits.habit: Always has big headphones round their neck, with music playing
clues: A waitress heard faint music from the basement, as if from someone's headphones, though there's no radio down there. The culprit wears headphones.
A soft ear cushion from big headphones lies by the body. The culprit wears headphones.

habits.label: Folds paper cranes
habits.habit: Absent-mindedly folds cranes out of napkins
clues: Under Touka's hand lies a crane folded from an Anteiku napkin. The culprit folds paper cranes.
All the napkins are gone from the holder on a far table, and the offcuts are on the windowsill by the basement. The culprit folds paper cranes.

habits.label: White streak
habits.habit: One completely white streak in dark hair
clues: A long, completely white hair lies on the basement steps. The culprit has a white streak.
Touka is clutching a short white hair, and Touka herself is dark-haired. The culprit has a white streak.

habits.label: Giggles at odd moments
habits.habit: Starts giggling when scared and can't stop
clues: Just before something crashed in the basement, a customer at the counter heard a thin giggle from down there. The culprit giggles at odd moments.
The barista heard someone giggling behind the kitchen door, then the bolt on the stairs down clanked. The culprit giggles at odd moments.

habits.label: High heels
clues: The wooden basement steps have deep dots from thin heels. The culprit wears heels.
A worn heel tip was found under the pillar in the basement. The culprit wears heels.

habits.label: Coloured contacts
habits.habit: Wears coloured contact lenses and keeps rubbing their eyes
clues: A dark contact lens is floating in the back room sink. The culprit wears coloured contacts.
A customer saw someone by the basement door squinting with one eye, as if they'd lost a lens. The culprit wears coloured contacts.

strong: Touka was slammed back-first into the concrete pillar so hard that it cracked. Throwing a ghoul like that takes enormous strength. The culprit is physically strong.
The cold room door was blocked with a rack of coffee bean sacks that not every removal man could shift. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: Ghouls with their sharp hearing were sitting in the café, and nobody heard footsteps towards the basement. The culprit can move silently.
The bell over the kitchen door rings at the slightest draught, yet that night it stayed silent, though the door was opened. The culprit can move silently.
tools: The straps of the mask at the back of Touka's head were bound with steel wire, and now it can't be taken off without wire cutters. The culprit is good with their hands.
The grinder on the counter was reset so that it droned nonstop and drowned out the sounds from the basement. The culprit is good with their hands.
medic: Ordinary sleeping drugs don't work on a ghoul, yet Touka didn't fight back: her coffee was laced with an Rc suppressant. The culprit knows medicine.
The kakuhou was cut out precisely, without touching the spine. That's how someone who knows a ghoul's body cuts. The culprit knows medicine.
keys: The basement door is locked at night, and the key is kept in the manager's desk. Later it was found on a nail by the door, and the lock is intact. The culprit had a key.
A parcel is missing from the cold room with the supplies, and the padlock is intact and locked. The culprit had a key.
safe: The 20th Ward ghouls' sign for "outsiders keep out" is drawn in chalk on the basement door. Only insiders can read it. The culprit knows the secret signs.
Touka was called downstairs by a message with names of coffee blends in place of words. It's an old Anteiku cipher. The culprit knows the secret signs.
sched: Every evening at 23:30 Touka goes down to grind the beans for the morning. Only the staff know that. The culprit knows the café routine.
At 23:35 the music on the café floor is turned off and the till is counted, so everyone is looking at the counter. That's when someone went to the basement. The culprit knows the café routine.
tech: The camera over the back door recorded all night, but from 23:20 to 23:50 the footage loops the same minute. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
At 23:40 the Doves' radios outside the window hissed with static: a homemade jammer was running in the basement. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
cash: The café's errand boy was sent for cigarettes to the other end of the ward and given a single ten-thousand-yen note for it. The culprit has money to spare.
A receipt from a secret ghoul restaurant was found in the basement for a sum a waiter couldn't earn in a year. The culprit has money to spare.
passages: An old crawlway leads from Anteiku's basement to the storm drains and on into the underground of the 24th Ward. The culprit knows the underground passages.
The drain grate in the basement floor was recently lifted from below: the rust on its rim has been rubbed off. The culprit knows the underground passages.
